:::{#def-relative-change-stopping-criterion}
#### Relative change stopping criterion

Let $\epsilon > 0$.
The **relative change stopping criterion** with tolerance $\epsilon$ stops [gradient descent](#def-gradient-descent) at the first $t$ for which $f(\iterpoint{\vx}{t}) \ne 0$ and

$$
\frac{\abs{f(\iterpoint{\vx}{t+1}) - f(\iterpoint{\vx}{t})}}{\abs{f(\iterpoint{\vx}{t})}} < \epsilon.
$$

:::
